subject: Discovery follow-up: Private/VPC architecture review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finapps.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: Private/VPC architecture review

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the proposed next step:

- Goals we heard: run customer-facing inference workloads in a private VPC with strict egress controls, bring-your-own-key (KMS) for model keys, and predictable throughput for SLAs.
- Primary constraints: corporate firewall policies, SOC 2 evidence, and a procurement timeline targeting production by Q4.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute Private/VPC architecture review / technical deep dive with our Solutions Engineering and Infra teams to walk through network topology, routing options, KMS integration, and a short compatibility checklist for your infra team. We usually cover:

  1) High-level architecture and control-plane vs data-plane separation
  2) Network requirements (egress, peering, routing, IP ranges)
  3) Authentication & KMS/HSM options
  4) On-prem and hybrid options if needed
  5) Pre-req checklist and follow-up artifacts (security questionnaire, SOC 2 excerpts)

Would you be available for one of these slots next week?
- Tue, Jun 8, 10:00-11:00 AM PT
- Wed, Jun 9, 1:00-2:00 PM PT

If neither works, send me 2-3 times that do and I’ll coordinate. I’ve attached the security questionnaire you mentioned and a short VPC guide we’ll reference in the call.

Attaching: finapps_security_questionnaire.pdf

CCing Neha (Solutions Eng) who will lead the technical portion.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0124
https://redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finapps.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: Private/VPC architecture review

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the questionnaire. Both Samantha (our infra/security lead) and I reviewed the doc. A couple quick items before we lock the meeting:

- We will want the meeting to include our infra lead (Samantha) and one engineer who handles VPC networking. I’ve CC'd Samantha here.
- Can you confirm expected attendees from Redwood and whether we should expect any packet capture or ports testing during the call?
- Our preferred windows are Tue/Wed afternoons PT. The Wed slot you proposed looks good for us.

Wed, Jun 9, 1:00-2:00 PM PT works — please send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Also — we noticed an item in the questionnaire about HSM integration. Do you support AWS CloudHSM and customer-managed key rotation? If there’s a short doc you can share that would help our security review.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Platform Engineering | FinApps
alex.johnson@finapps.com | (650) 555-3310

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finapps.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: Private/VPC architecture review

Alex —

Great — thanks for confirming. I’ve penciled Wed, Jun 9, 1:00-2:00 PM PT. I’ll send the invite once David (Infra) confirms — he’s our lead on Private deployments and will walk through network/topology. Neha will run the compatibility checklist and KMS options.

Expected Redwood attendees:
- Marissa Cole (AE) — meeting owner/coordination
- Neha Kapoor (Solutions Engineer) — technical deep dive and checklist
- David Kim (Infra Engineer) — VPC routing, peering, and firewall requirements

Short agenda (we’ll include in the invite):
- 5m intros & objectives
- 20m high-level architecture & deployment modes (VPC, private control plane, on-prem)
- 20m network requirements and KMS/HSM options (David + Neha)
- 10m Q&A and next actions (procurement, SOC 2 evidence, follow-ups)

Attachments: redwood_vpc_lite_guide.pdf (short primer)

On the HSM question: we support AWS CloudHSM for key storage patterns and customer-managed rotation via KMS integrations; David will share configuration patterns during the call and a short write-up after.

I’ll send the calendar invite to the attendees and include the meeting notes doc and the HubSpot deal link. Any additional folks on your side to add?

Best,
Marissa

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finapps.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: Private/VPC architecture review

Marissa / Alex —

Confirmed for Wed, Jun 9, 1:00-2:00 PM PT. I’ve added our network engineer (Ben Harris) to the invite — he’ll bring packet/port questions. Please include any network ranges and ports you'll require ahead of time so we can loop in the right folks.

Samantha Lee
Sr. Infrastructure Security Manager | FinApps
samantha.lee@finapps.com
